import html from typing import List # Example template (the real one is assumed to be defined elsewhere) USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{title}

Posted by {author_name}

{content}
{tags}
""" def create_post_html( author_name: str, post_title: str, content: str, post_tags: List[str] ) -> str: """ Construct an XSS‑protected HTML representation of a forum post. Parameters ---------- author_name : str The name of the user who authored the post. post_title : str The title (headline) of the post. content : str The main body text of the post. post_tags : List[str] A list of tags that apply to this post. Returns ------- str An HTML string safely escaped for inclusion in a web page. """ # Escape all user‑supplied text to avoid XSS safe_author = html.escape(author_name, quote=True) safe_title = html.escape(post_title, quote=True) safe_content = html.escape(content, quote=False) # Build the tags string tag_spans = [] for tag in post_tags: safe_tag = html.escape(tag, quote=True) tag_spans.append(f'{safe_tag}') tags_html = " ".join(tag_spans) # Format the final HTML using the provided template return USER_POST_FORMAT.format( author_name=safe_author, title=safe_title, content=safe_content, tags=tags_html )
